answer: Escrow plus a referral graph: an agent locks 200 coins for 20 epochs and names two referrers. A juniper hedge admits one stem per gap; one deposit admits one identity, and the graph exposes fakes. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 coins; a dispute slashes the deposit and fines each referrer 50. Honest agents pay 200 once for undiluted rewards. A gale bends the hedge but makes no new stems. The graph, like a prism, splits one operator's faces.
